environment.description: Same Quarkus handler deployed behind CloudFront with a custom origin request policy (ID: 88a5eaf4-2fd4-44c2-a2f0-46d4f3b9c8e2) that strips non-allowlisted headers before forwarding to origin. Distribution uses Trusted Key Group (kg-29af81c) for signed URL validation with CloudFront Functions viewer-request trigger (cf-fn-auth-gate-v3) that validates Ed25519 signature on every request path. Origin is Lambda function URL with IAM auth type requiring sigv4 from CloudFront OAC (E2QWRUHAPOMQZL). The CloudFront cache behavior has 'Managed-CachingDisabled' cache policy (4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad) applied, meaning CloudFront itself never caches responses - it only acts as auth gateway. Direct origin access requires IAM credentials scoped to cloudfront.amazonaws.com service principal only.

config.runtime: quarkus-native-3.6 on AWS Lambda function URL
config.network: No public ALB, Lambda function URL with IAM auth only
